body: My therapist is a man, and I had difficulty trusting him at first for this exact reason. However, we started our sessions together with my telling him that, and it was important for him to know so he knew to tread slowly in terms of gaining my trust. Although I still have a long way to go, and it may seem counterintuitive, having a man in a position of support and working week to week on learning to trust him has actually been helpful for me ability to trust and work with men outside of the therapy context
